items.name: Zobrist hash
items.description: Assign random values to objects and combine them additively or by XOR to compare multisets, states, or occurrence patterns.

items.name: Rolling hash
items.description: Maintain substring or sequence hashes with incremental window updates or prefix-hash differences.

items.name: Modular fingerprint
items.description: Represent large objects or algebraic expressions by residue vectors under one or more moduli for probabilistic equality checks.
